name: 338. Voyage text embeddings
description: TXE-6436: unified text embeddings, usage and unsupported parameters. Fixture rows use providerErrorFixture=1 with provider-error-fixture.config.json and provider-error-fixture.mjs; voyageFixtureUrl overrides the fixture URL when remapped to a free local port. The fixture counts the entire multi-input batch on both 200 and 500. Live rows cover all three price tiers. No rerank, multimodal or native Voyage route.

item.name: Voyage embeddings fixture batch success voyage-4

exec: if (pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixture') !== '1') { pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
pm.variables.set('voyageBatchTag', 'voyage-batch-' + pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'));
var b = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Voyage fixture status', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('vendor usage preserved', function () { pm.expect(b.usage.prompt_tokens).to.equal(7); pm.expect(b.usage.total_tokens).to.equal(7); pm.expect(b.data.length).to.equal(3); });
pm.sendRequest((pm.variables.get('voyageFixtureUrl') || 'http://127.0.0.1:8791') + '/__wire', function (err, response) {

pm.test('one complete batch call, including on failure', function () { pm.expect(err).to.equal(null); var calls = response.json().data[0].calls.filter(function (c) { return c.path === '/v1/embeddings' && c.body.indexOf(pm.variables.get('voyageBatchTag')) !== -1; }); pm.expect(calls.length).to.equal(1); var wire = JSON.parse(calls[0].body); pm.expect(wire.input.length).to.equal(3); pm.expect(wire.output_dimension).to.equal(256); pm.expect(wire.input_type).to.equal('document'); pm.expect(wire.output_dtype).to.equal('float'); });
